title: Workspace actor-free Project row read
description: Caller-transactional, unlocked read of the complete Project snapshot and typed Labeling counters. It does not inspect an actor, decide permissions, or acquire row or advisory locks.

ProjectRowJson.description: Null when no Project matches; otherwise a lossless text JSON object containing the full 43-column Project row with counters supplied by the typed Labeling capability.

x-native-capabilities.authorization_boundary: The caller owns authorization and workflow decisions; this function performs no actor or permission checks.

functions.name: read_project_row
functions.transaction_semantics: Read the complete Project row and typed Labeling counters in the caller's existing transaction. A missing Project returns null. The function acquires no locks and does not commit.

x-native-capabilities.transaction_boundary: The caller owns the surrounding transaction and commit.
